# 021-hotel

**Provider.** Marriott (Marriott Bonvoy), direct booking at a Courtyard property, English.

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts. Dark Marriott Bonvoy header with the member's name, masked member number and tier, a brand band with the hotel name, a ruled confirmation number row, check-in and check-out columns, a reservation details table, room charges, the cancellation terms under "Rate Guarantee Limitations", and the hotel address at the bottom.

**Why.** US date and 12-hour time formats at a German hotel ("Check-out Time: 12:00 PM" is noon). The rate is printed per night per room over a date range, with a cash subtotal and estimated taxes leading to the total; the cancellation fee (138.68 EUR) and parking price are distractors. The address is split over lines in US order ("Berlin, 10243 Germany") and is only in the footer block. The masked Bonvoy member number sits near the guest name and must not be taken as a reference; the cancellation terms sit under a heading that does not say "cancellation".
